mapper.select: SELECT id, record_date, meal_type, remark FROM diet_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND record_date = #{date} ORDER BY FIELD(meal_type,'breakfast','lunch','dinner','snack'), create_time
SELECT id, record_date, meal_type, remark FROM diet_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND record_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY record_date DESC, create_time DESC
SELECT id, record_date, meal_type, remark FROM diet_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND YEAR(record_date) = #{year} AND MONTH(record_date) = #{month} ORDER BY record_date, create_time
